product_one_liner.value: Design Arena lets creators build and compare AI-generated websites, apps, images, video and other creative outputs, while using community feedback to benchmark model quality.
product_one_liner.notes: The homepage describes creation tools and crowdsourced model comparisons.

pricing_page.notes: No public pricing page was found; the homepage navigation and footer contain no pricing link.

named_customers.notes: Funding coverage mentions unnamed frontier AI lab customers, but no source verified at least two named customers. Model providers are not treated as customers.

employee_band.notes: The verified LinkedIn profile reports 2–10 employees, outside the permitted bands. Other search results conflict. The required value is a schema placeholder, not an asserted band.

hq_location.notes: The company profile identifies San Francisco, California, United States as headquarters.

founded_year.notes: Both sources identify 2025 as the founding year.

eng_blog.notes: Two first-party implementation write-ups describe the team's open-source AgentRunner harness and HTML-to-PPTX conversion library, including architecture, execution details and code. They are attributed to the organization rather than individually named engineers.

public_docs.notes: The inspected navigation and footer expose methodology, model information and policies, but no public multi-article documentation site or help center.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current job-board listing includes Member of Technical Staff, ML Engineer, originally posted April 24, 2026. Intelligence is the company behind Design Arena.

model_provider.value: Multiple providers, including OpenAI, Anthropic, Google (Gemini), xAI (Grok), Mistral, DeepSeek, Meta (Llama), and Moonshot AI (Kimi).
model_provider.notes: The model-provider terms list these providers; the AgentRunner article also describes multi-provider support. This is not an exhaustive list.

compliance_certs.notes: No qualifying certification of Design Arena itself was verified. The security page mentions SOC 2 and ISO 27001 certifications of its infrastructure providers, which are not treated as the company's own certifications.

last_funding.notes: Intelligence, the company behind Design Arena, announced a $7.9 million seed round on August 3, 2026, led by Index Ventures.

raised_18mo.notes: The August 3, 2026 seed announcement falls within May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The readable board lists four technical roles: Post-Training Research, Frontier Evals, ML Engineer and Product Engineering; none is an SDR, BDR or account executive role. The retrieved board identifies its snapshot as November 10, 2026, one day after the requested run date.

launched_6mo.notes: The article introduces Audio Realism Bench, a new benchmark for conversational audio realism. Its retrieved publication date is August 4, 2026, within the May 9–November 9 window; the blog index displays a different date that is also within the window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: No complete leadership roster with start dates or dated executive appointment/departure announcement was verified. The value is a required schema placeholder, not a negative finding.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The readable job-board material did not name a CRM or sales/marketing system. AI model integrations are not counted as the company's sales stack.
